item.title: Christianity's hardest objections have surprising answers - Faith Lab
item.description: Rebecca McLaughlin joins Faith Lab to confront Christianity’s hardest questions and explore whether faith in Jesus holds up today.

item.title: Tim Mackie: How to Read the Bible - Faith Lab
item.description: Tim Mackie explains how the Bible actually communicates... not as a rulebook, but through story, pattern, and structure.

item.title: Tim Mackie: The Bible Isn't What You Think - Faith Lab
item.description: Tim Mackie reveals narrative riddles hidden in Genesis, why the Bible isn't a rulebook, and why "faithfulness" matters more than "inerrancy."

item.title: Are the Gospel Birth Narratives Historical? - Faith Lab
item.description: Scholar Caleb Friedeman tested whether ancient birth narratives were meant to be historical. What he found reframes the Gospel Christmas stories.

item.title: Do the Gospel Birth Narratives Contradict? - Faith Lab
item.description: Scholar Caleb Friedeman examines whether the gospel birth narratives contradict each other, and why the evidence may point to surprising reliability.

item.title: N.T. Wright: Did Jesus Really Rise from the Dead? - Faith Lab
item.description: Did Jesus really rise from the dead? N.T. Wright, a leading scholar, walks through the historical evidence historians evaluate. Listen to the case.

item.title: N.T. Wright: Do Christians Go to Heaven When They Die? - Faith Lab
item.description: Do Christians go to heaven when they die? N.T. Wright explains resurrection, new creation, and why Christian hope is bigger than most believers think.

item.title: What Happened After the Apostles Died? How Polycarp Bridges the Gap - Faith Lab
item.description: What happened after the apostles died? Polycarp was born 35 years after Jesus, knew the eyewitnesses, and his own words survive today.

item.title: Are the Gospels Historically Reliable? What the Evidence Shows - Faith Lab
item.description: Are the Gospels historically reliable? NT scholar Lydia McGrew explains the reportage model and the evidence most Christians have never been shown.

item.title: What Did the Early Church Believe About the Cross? The Atonement Before Penal Substitution - Faith Lab
item.description: The earliest Christians understood the cross differently than most of us were taught. Explore the early church view of the atonement and why it matters.
